form.label: Paste a social media link

hint.otherPlatform: The downloader handles every supported platform, so this link works here too.
hint.publicOnly: Public posts only. The platform is detected automatically.
notice.notLiveBody: We recognised this {platform} {contentType} link, but the YoniXTools download service is not connected. Nothing was downloaded.
notice.serviceLaunch: Link detection is live now. Downloading turns on when the YoniXTools download service launches.
result.bulkHint: Choose what to save. Each item downloads on its own, or select several for one ZIP.
result.chooseQuality: Choose a quality. The download starts right away.
status.facebook.note: Some videos are only served to logged-in users and can't be downloaded.
status.instagram.content: Reels, videos, single photos, carousels and mixed posts
status.instagram.note: Every photo and video of a post, each with its own download, or several as a ZIP. Stories need a login, so they're not supported.
status.kick.note: Clips only; live streams and VODs aren't supported.
status.mixcloud.note: Public shows, as original audio or MP3.
status.soundcloud.note: Tracks the artist makes publicly streamable.
status.tiktok.note: Clean (no-watermark) file when TikTok provides one. A few posts are region-locked.
status.twitch.note: Clips only; live streams and full broadcasts aren't supported.
status.x.note: Posts marked sensitive or from protected accounts need a login.
transfer.requestedNote: Your browser was asked to save the file. Nothing in your downloads? <link>Save it here</link>.
unavailable.reddit: Reddit downloads aren't available: Reddit currently refuses requests from our server. We don't use accounts to get around this.
unavailable.vimeo: Vimeo downloads aren't available: Vimeo now requires an account or serves DRM-protected streams to servers.
unavailable.youtube: YouTube downloads aren't available: YouTube asks our server to sign in to prove it isn't a bot, and we don't use accounts to get around this.
